fieldOrder.label: Order of the delivery fields
fieldOrder.help: Name, phone and address in the order the customer fills them in. A field left out is added at the end.

enabled.label: Show "Try it on in front of the rider"
enabled.help: A line under the delivery promise. Switch it on only when your riders really wait while the customer tries the item.

enabled.label: Show "Need help? WhatsApp us" on the checkout
enabled.help: A line at the top of the checkout and a box under the summary on a computer. It shows only when the shop's WhatsApp number is set.

nameMin.label: Shortest name the order takes (letters)
nameMin.help: A name shorter than this asks the customer to write it in full.

addressMin.label: Shortest address the order takes (letters)
addressMin.help: An address shorter than this asks the customer for more, so the rider can find the house.

enabled.label: Offer mobile banking
enabled.help: bKash, Nagad and the other wallets in the list below. Until the wallet's key is entered in Keys & connections, payment runs on the test (mock) page.

list.label: Mobile wallets shown
list.help: The wallets the customer can pick, in this order.

enabled.label: Offer card and bank payment
enabled.help: Visa, Mastercard, Amex and internet banking. Until the card gateway's key is entered, payment runs on the test (mock) page.

list.label: Cards shown
list.help: The card types the customer can pick, in this order.

enabled.label: Offer "Pay online" (one secure payment page)
enabled.help: One option that sends the customer to the payment gateway's own page for cards, mobile banking and net banking.

enabled.label: Give a reward for paying before delivery
enabled.help: Any payment except Cash on Delivery earns it. Off until you decide. The reward shows next to each payment option and is taken back if the customer switches to Cash on Delivery.

type.label: What the reward is
type.help: Free delivery, a fixed amount off, or a percentage off the items.

fallback.label: When delivery is already free, give instead
fallback.help: A free-delivery reward is worth nothing on an order that already ships free, so the customer gets this one instead.

amountMinor.label: Amount off (fixed reward)
amountMinor.help: Taken off the items. Empty means no amount reward.

percent.label: Percentage off (percentage reward)
percent.help: A percentage of the items' price. Empty means no percentage reward.

maxMinor.label: Largest percentage reward
maxMinor.help: The most a percentage reward can take off one order. Empty means no cap.
